comment:
The maker calls this an ADR envelope, but the attack level doubles as a sustain level and the delay is the held stage, so it behaves as an attack, sustain, delay, release generator. A dedicated A.trig or DR.trig input takes priority over the Phase input when both are patched.
MAKER BUG: ADREnvelope.cpp:498 drives the four phase outputs from outTrig[i].running(), which is true for the whole 1ms high plus 1ms low of the pulse, where every other module in the plugin uses isHigh() and gets a 1ms pulse. These outputs are therefore high for 2ms and have no forced low gap. The same line takes its levels from gateOutHigh and gateOutLow, so the Trigger-high output-level and Trigger-low output-level items on this module's menu are never read.
